module: dist/study_math.js (UMD: require() in Node, window.StudyMath in browser)

exports.ctrb(A, B): C = [B, AB, ..., A^(n-1)B], n x nq; B may be a flat vector (single input) or array of rows
exports.ctrbBlocks(A, B): list of the n blocks A^k B
exports.svd(M): {sigma: descending singular values (length = rows of M), U: left singular vectors}; one-sided Jacobi on M^T
exports.rankInfo(M, relTol=1e-9): {sigma, U, rank, relTol, cond}; rank counts sigma_i > relTol*sigma_max; sigma_max <= 1e-12 -> rank 0; cond Infinity if rank deficient
exports.controllability(A, B, relTol): {C, sigma, U, rank, n, controllable, cond, relTol}
exports.explorerModel({c, b1, b2, alpha, beta, d: A=[[1,c],[0,2]], B=[[b1],[b2]] or [[1,b1],[0,b2]] if dual; returns A,B,b,Ab,AB,C,sigma,rank,controllable,cond,det (single input: b2*(b1-c*b2); null if dual), point=alpha*b+beta*Ab, line/w (rank 1: col-space direction and w with w^T C = 0)
exports.discreteTwoSteps(A, b, u0, u1): x1 = b u0, x2 = A b u0 + b u1 from x0 = 0 (discrete-time companion)

explorerIdentities: single input: rank < 2 iff b2 = 0 (b along eigenvector (1,0), eigenvalue 2 unmovable) or b1 = c*b2 (b along eigenvector (c,1), eigenvalue 1 unmovable); snapped 0.1 grid, e.g. c=0.2,b1=0.3,b2=1.5 gives det ~1e-17 -> rank 1 by tolerance
